allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3212/CV-Anderson-Benites-Yupanqui.pdf" -UseBasicParsing -Method Head; "CV -> {0} {1} bytes, {2}" -f $r.StatusCode, $r.Headers['Content-Length'], $r.Headers['Content-Type'] } catch { "CV -> ERROR " + $_.Exception.Message })

PowerShell(git status --short; Write-Output "--- REMOTE ---"; git remote -v; Write-Output "--- BRANCH ---"; git branch -vv; Write-Output "--- TRACKED COUNT ---"; \(git ls-files | Measure-Object -Line\).Lines)

PowerShell(foreach \($p in @\("robots.txt","sitemap.xml","CV-Anderson-Benites-Yupanqui.pdf"\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://mi-perfi-web.vercel.app/$p" -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output "$p -> $\($r.StatusCode\) | $\($r.Headers['Content-Type']\) | $\($r.RawContentLength\) bytes"; if \($p -ne "CV-Anderson-Benites-Yupanqui.pdf"\) { Write-Output $r.Content } } catch { Write-Output "$p -> ERROR $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell($body = @{ name = "Prueba de despliegue"; email = "andersonbenitesy@gmail.com"; message = "Mensaje de prueba automatico para verificar que Resend esta correctamente configurado en produccion. Puedes ignorarlo." } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://mi-perfi-web.vercel.app/api/contact" -Method POST -ContentType "application/json" -Body $body -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Output $r.Content } catch { $s = $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__; Write-Output "STATUS: $s"; $sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader\($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream\(\)\); Write-Output $sr.ReadToEnd\(\) })
